pages.name: Two Knights Defence:Lolli Variation, Pincus Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 played Ne4 with no knight able to reach it; plan 2's ...c6 is impossible (a knight stands on c6). Rewritten around the pin on d5, Qe4, castling and Re1, and ...Kd7. British spelling.

pages.name: Two Knights Defence:Lolli Variation, Pincus Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 played Nc3 with a pawn on c3; rewritten (castle, a rook to the e-file, Nd2) after 9...Ke6.

pages.name: Two Knights Defense, Fried Liver Attack
pages.notes: Plan 1 had White castle queenside (b1, c1 and d1 are occupied); plan 2 sent the king to g8 or f6, missing 7.Qf3+ Ke6. Rewrote the overview and both plans.

pages.name: Two Knights Defense, Traxler Counterattack, Knight Sacrifice Line
pages.notes: Plan 2's 'safe square (often g1 or h1)' rewritten as 7.Kg1 or the King March 7.Ke3, out of the knight's check.

pages.name: Two Knights Defense, Ulvestad Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 recaptured with ...bxc6 (Black has no b-pawn; 7.Bxc6+ is check and the queen takes). Overview and both plans rewritten around 7...Qxc6 and the bishop pair; British spelling.

pages.name: Two Knights Defense, Ulvestad Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 called the dark-squared bishop light-squared (c5); plan 2's Qe2 does not cover g2. Rewritten around ...Qxg2 and Qf3; British spelling.

pages.name: Two Knights Defense:Lolli Variation
pages.notes: Plan 4 called the d5-knight a 'central d5-pawn' and suggested ...b5; rewritten around the pinned knight and ...Kd7. British spelling.

pages.name: Two Knights, Traxler Counterattack
pages.notes: Plan 1 sent the queen to h4 through the king on e7; plan 3 activated a d8-rook that is a queen. Both rewritten; overview now says the Traxler answers 4.Ng5. British spelling.

pages.name: Two Knights, Traxler Counterattack
pages.notes: Plan 1's ...Qh4 and ...Qg5 are blocked by the king on e7; plan 2 had White castle queenside with b1, c1 and d1 occupied. Rewritten around ...Bg4, ...Qd4, d3 and short castling.

pages.name: Two Knights: 4.Ng5 d5 5.exd5 Nxd5
pages.notes: Plan 2's '...Ke6' came without 6.Nxf7 Kxf7 7.Qf3+; plan 1's 'Qf3-d5' rewritten around Nc3 against the pinned knight; plan 3's e-file pin didn't exist yet. British spelling.
